=== effective paths and ports in both directions ===
Paths:
  rx   PATH                  /commands
  r    config                /configuration/first-long-reference-directory
                             /somewhere-else/second-long-reference-directory
  rw   config + temporary    /reference
  rw   temporary             /output

Ports:
  Host http://127.9.9.9:3000 → Sandbox 3000
  Host http://127.9.9.9:3001 → Sandbox 3001
  Sandbox 8080 → Host 127.0.0.1:8080
  Sandbox 8081 → Host 127.0.0.1:8081
=== every permanent path kind ===
Paths:
  rw   cache + sockets       /cache
  r    drops                 /drops
  rw   git                   /repo/**/.git
  rw   home                  /home
  r    modules               /go-mod
  r    runtime               /runtime
  rw   runtime               /ptys
  r    skills                /skill/{one,two}
  r    system                /etc/one
  rw   system                /dev/null
  rx   system                /usr
  rxw  tmp + sockets         /tmp
=== built-in paths ===
Paths:
  rx   PATH                  /path/{one,two}
  r    modules               /modules/cache
  r    runtime               /runtime/process
  rw   runtime               /runtime/ptys
  r    skills                /skills/{one,two}
  r    system                /system/read
  rw   system                /system/devices
  rx   system                /system/bin
=== read-only workspace ===
Paths:
  r    workspace             /workspace
=== writable workspace and denied names ===
Paths:
  rw   workspace             /workspace

Denied:
  secrets.yml, expenses.yml, domains.yml, auth.json, creds.json, .env, .env.prod, production
=== yolo ===
Paths:
  rxw  workspace             /workspace
  rxw  yolo shell            /
=== host to sandbox alone ===
Ports:
  Host http://127.9.9.9:8080 → Sandbox 8080
=== sandbox to host alone ===
Ports:
  Sandbox 3000 → Host 127.0.0.1:3000
=== nothing granted ===
No grants or routes.
